items.title: ARISS receives Challenger-7 recognition
items.blurb: Amateur Radio on the International Space Station was named a Challenger-7 honoree as part of the Challenger Center's 40th anniversary. Frank Bauer KA3HDO said the student-ISS contacts carry the same exploration and STEM brief as the STS-51-L crew. Other honorees include AIAA, the American Rocketry Challenge, and Janet's Planet.

items.title: Year of the Club: website and newsletter contest winners
items.blurb: More than 80 entries in each contest. Website first: Cumberland Valley ARC W3ACH. Newsletter firsts by size: Gloucester County ARC W2MMD, Ozaukee Radio Club W9CQO, and Peekskill/Cortlandt ARA W2NYW. Winners get a nod at Huntsville, 21–23 August, and in QST.

items.title: Arizona 10-year-old KM7HFU licensed, given an FT-857D
items.blurb: Reynaldo Mangual passed Technician and is now KM7HFU. Maricopa Amateur Radio Association handed him a donated Yaesu FT-857D, LDG YT-100 tuner, and a restored WWII J-38 key. He is MARA's youngest member and also in the Pinal County 4-H club.

items.title: SM/DF7CW on Kungsleden through 27 August, spotting via SOTAmāt
items.blurb: Nils DF7CW is QRV 16–27 August as SM/DF7CW, aiming at six never-activated POTA parks plus a SOTA summit on Sweden's King's Trail. No cell. Spots go Garmin inReach Mini 2 to SOTAmāt, then onto the POTA/SOTA cluster. Trail radio is a Mountain Topper Currahee at 5 W CW.

items.title: RI8KR — Ob Bay islands, Kara Sea, 21–28 August
items.blurb: Vladimir RK8A and Igor UA3EDQ plan four new RRA island groups in the Ob Bay. Three also count for IOTA AS-109, quiet since 2013. 40–10 m, CW, SSB, maybe digital. QSL via RZ3EC and LoTW. Official page at robinsons.ru/ri8kr.
